text: Assumption: The caller or the system integration shall ensure the prevention of concurrent calls because the function is specified as non-reentrant and non-interruptible, but is permitted to be called from ISR, OS, and OS-free contexts — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The caller or the system integration shall ensure the prevention of concurrent calls because the function is specified as non-reentrant and non-interruptible, but is permitted to be called from ISR, OS, and OS-free contexts — is this correct?
norm: the caller or the system integration shall ensure the prevention of concurrent calls because the function is specified as non reentrant and non interruptible but is permitted to be called from isr os and os free contexts
assumption: The caller or the system integration shall ensure the prevention of concurrent calls because the function is specified as non-reentrant and non-interruptible, but is permitted to be called from ISR, OS, and OS-free contexts.
rationale: SWS_EcuM_02828 excludes reentrancy and interruptibility, while SWS_EcuM_02807 permits the calling contexts without stating internal synchronization mechanisms.

original.text: Annahme: Da die Funktion Non-Reentrant und Non-Interruptible spezifiziert ist, aber aus ISR-, OS- und OS-freien Kontexten aufgerufen werden darf, dürfte die Vermeidung nebenläufiger Aufrufe durch den Aufrufer oder die Systemintegration sichergestellt werden müssen — trifft das zu?
